name: dicom-imaging-toolkit-packages
description: Monorepo for the DICOM imaging toolkit: a shared geometry core and the RT/SEG domain packages built on it.
author: Adeel Khan

comments.overrides: adm-zip <0.6.0 (GHSA-xcpc-8h2w-3j85) reaches the tree only transitively via dcmjs, which pins adm-zip@0.5.17. The domain packages never touch dcmjs's zip features (port.ts uses DicomDict/DicomMessage/DicomMetaDictionary only); pinning the patched line removes the advisory outright.

scripts.test: npm run check:deps && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
